research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01. Frozen occupation list empty; absence is not zero experience. Employer, council, public professional and reporting sources establish a substantial entertainment, production, research and advocacy career. No unsupported public/private full-time total manufactured.

Follow-up: original CV/payroll or contracts for Yamba/Imparja versus Yangapi, historical legal ownership/nonprofit form and production dates; performance fee records, consultancy business name, clients and working hours. Public LinkedIn dates are indexed, not a fully inspected profile.

Follow-up: CIS termination and workload, Advance appointment/cessation and pay/legal organisation category, media contracts and paid versus unpaid contributions; exact council departure and any leave. Concurrent music, production, council, research and commentary spans must not be summed as independent full-time years.

Follow-up: paid mentoring years and MusicNT contracts; authorship contract and post-election income period. Publication, awards, programme establishment and political prominence are not evidence of full-time status. Further early jobs remain possible.

Searched own and party biographies, maiden speech, council 2015–16/2016–17 reports and history, employer CIS 2019 annual review, public professional index, Advance announcement, MusicNT chronology, ABC Australian Story testimony and publisher/collaborator book listing. Personal health/family history and unrelated contemporary controversies omitted.

Recovered source gaps: CIS report (403) Forbidden; council report and LinkedIn direct opens returned Internal Error without detailed message. Public indexed primary facts used with locators; no access controls bypassed. Exact dates and hours remain gaps; blocked is not research completion.

CIS broader2016–2022involvement distinguished fromJuly2019director commencement; party testimony is not judicially established finding.
